message.content:
Based on the visual analysis of the time series plot, there is a distinct level shift (anomaly) occurring around x = 605. The values jump from a range of approximately 2-5 mm to a new baseline of roughly 14-18 mm and stay elevated for the remainder of the series.

The anomaly can be described as starting at the jump point and continuing to the end of the data.

[[605, 730]]
